title: omnipod dash Error
body:
Dear Support Team,

I’m currently experiencing some issues with the Omnipod DASH system while using version v1, and I would like to ask for your assistance.

1. Profile Change Error
When changing the profile on the Omnipod DASH, the basal insulin is automatically set to 0 units for 4800 minutes. On the mainboard screen, it appears that the profile has changed correctly, but Nightscout shows that the basal insulin remains at 0 and the profile hasn’t actually changed.
The only way to apply the correct basal insulin settings from the profile is to either activate a temporary basal rate or wait for an automatic basal adjustment based on blood glucose levels.
Currently, I have to manually enable a temporary basal after selecting a profile in order for it to function correctly, which is quite inconvenient.


2. Profile Ratio Adjustment Issue
The profile settings do not apply the desired percentage-based changes.



I’ve read that these issues have been resolved in version v3

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c640ad8-6245-49e1-bcb5-107e59f1e00a)

, but unfortunately, my phone is not compatible with v3, so I have no choice but to continue using v1.
Is there any workaround or recommended solution for these problems while using v1?

I would greatly appreciate your help and any advice you could provide.

Thank you very much for your time and support.
